contracts.actual_behavior: Powered entityInside LivingEntity not POSSESSED_ARMOR_TEAM requests impale8, without local server guard and with native damage admission. Damage occurs BEFORE step-trigger activation, so the activating collision starts power but does not damage from old unpowered state. POWERED=false/POWER_ON_STEP=false by default. Step mode activates only living nonteam, excluding creative players; own state POWERED=true. Server neighborChanged compares native signal with POWERED: powered mismatch schedules immediate tick, unpowered mismatch cycles state. Scheduled tick turns off when powered with no signal; updateShape independently schedules20, permitting step reset. Placement and rotation reset power; constant fullXZ/height2/16 shape irrespective power. No extra damage output or redstone power implementation. Creative exemption is activation-only, not powered hurt predicate.
